transfagarasan-north-south.title: Transfăgărășan North–South
transfagarasan-north-south.slogan: Romania's ridge road: tunnels, dam wall and a glacial lake at the top. · out and back
transfagarasan-north-south.story: Built as a military road across the Făgăraș ridge, the Transfăgărășan spends its best kilometres above the treeline. The northern ramps are the spectacular half; the southern side runs longer and gentler past the Vidraru dam. It is only open in the warm months and the top can shut with no notice, so treat any plan as provisional.

waypoints.name: Bâlea Cascadă
waypoints.advice: Bâlea Cascadă comes up 22 km in. The road climbs 634 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 5 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Bâlea Lake tunnel, climbing 808 m.

waypoints.name: Bâlea Lake tunnel
waypoints.advice: 2042 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 808 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Vidraru Dam, mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 17 km. 634 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2042 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Transfagarasan Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 33 km this is Transfagarasan Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 17 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
